findings.evidence: The diff deletes all three files; `find code/TauCeti/NumberTheory/Multiquadratic -maxdepth 1 -type f` shows only `MinusTwentyOneExamples.lean`, and `rg -n "PrimeDiscriminantExampleRoots|PrimeDiscriminantDegreeExamples|MinusTwentyOneGalois" code/TauCeti` finds no replacement modules.
findings.fix: Keep compatibility shim modules at the deleted paths, each importing `TauCeti.NumberTheory.Multiquadratic.MinusTwentyOneExamples` and documenting the move.
findings.issue: The PR deletes the public modules `PrimeDiscriminantExampleRoots.lean`, `PrimeDiscriminantDegreeExamples.lean`, and `MinusTwentyOneGalois.lean`, so downstream users importing those module names break even though the declarations were merely consolidated.

summary: The refactor preserves the main theorem names, but it deletes public module import paths, which is a user-visible API break for downstream files that imported the old example modules.
